Speech to Speech [图标] grok-voice-latest [图标] Real-time speech-to-speech conversations with tool use, powered by Grok. Latency Sub-second Realtime $0.08 / min Endpoint /v1/realtime Read docsTry in playground Text to Speech [图标] Generate speech with expressive multilingual voices, speech tags, and telephony codecs. Voices Expressive, multilingual Pricing $15.00 / 1M chars Endpoint /v1/tts Read docsTry in playground Speech to Text [图标] Transcribe audio to text in 38+ languages with batch and streaming modes. Batch $0.10 / hour Streaming $0.20 / hour Endpoint /v1/stt Read docsTry in playground Speech to Speech Build real-time, speech-to-speech voice agents over WebSockets, with low-latency turn-taking and tool use. For client-side apps, use Ephemeral Tokens to connect securely without exposing your API key. View docs Python JavaScript [图标] import asyncio import json import os import websockets async def voice_agent(): async with websockets.connect( "wss://api.x.ai/v1/realtime?model=grok-voice-latest", additional_headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['XAI_API_KEY']}"} ) as ws: # Configure voice and enable tools await ws.send(json.dumps({ "type": "session.update", "session": { "voice": "eve", "instructions": "You are a helpful customer support agent.", "turn_detection": {"type": "server_vad"}, "tools": [{"type": "web_search"}] } })) # Stream audio and receive responses async for message in ws: event = json.loads(message) if event["type"] == "response.output_audio.delta": # Play audio: base64.b64decode(event["delta"]) pass asyncio.run(voice_agent()) [图标]Demo Apps: Web Agent · Twilio Phone Agent · WebRTC Agent · iOS Tester App Text to Speech Convert text to spoken audio with a large roster of expressive voices. Inline speech tags (laughter, whispers, pauses) and output formats from high-fidelity MP3 to telephony μ-law. Unary requests or WebSocket streaming. View docs Bash Python JavaScript [图标] curl -X POST https://api.x.ai/v1/tts \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $XAI_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "text": "Welcome to SpaceXSI. How can I help you today?", "voice_id": "eve", "language": "en" }' \ --output welcome.mp3 Real World Examples: LiveKit · Pipecat Speech to Text Transcribe audio files in a single call or stream over WebSocket. The default is grok-voice-transcribe-2.0. 12 audio formats, word-level timestamps, multichannel, speaker diarization, Smart Turn end-of-turn detection, and 38+ languages. View docs Bash Python JavaScript [图标] curl -X POST https://api.x.ai/v1/stt \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $XAI_API_KEY" \ -F model=grok-voice-transcribe-2.0 \ -F file=@recording.mp3 Real World Examples: Voximplant Quick Start: Custom Voices Clone a voice from a short reference clip, then use the resulting voice_id anywhere a built-in voice works: Bash Python JavaScript [图标] # 1. Create a custom voice from a reference audio clip (max 120s). curl -X POST https://api.x.ai/v1/custom-voices \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $XAI_API_KEY" \ -F "name=Friendly Narrator" \ -F "language=en" \ -F "file=@reference.wav;type=audio/wav" # Response: { "voice_id": "nlbqfwie", ... } # 2. Use the custom voice for TTS. curl -X POST https://api.x.ai/v1/tts \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $XAI_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "text": "Hello! This is my custom voice.", "voice_id": "nlbqfwie", "language": "en" }' \ --output custom.mp3 The custom voice_id also works with the streaming TTS WebSocket and the Speech to Speech realtime API. See the Custom Voices guide for the full API. Voices When using the Speech to Speech API or Text to Speech, you can choose from the full set of built-in voices. Each has its own personality and tone, and all of them can speak every supported language.
